plot: After completing Logout, Jin Taekyung wakes in the modern world after sleeping for forty-two hours. His mother and Hayeon panic, scold him, and beat his back, while Hayeon reveals that she already bought the most expensive massage chair with his card. Taekyung lies about waking during the night and invents a history of sleeping through high school to discourage further questions.

Team Leader Choi visits to take Taekyung to the Peace Guild's new-member workshop, which is actually a six-night, seven-day operation at an A-rank Gate. More than twenty rookie B-rank Hunters face a Stone Golem. Song Song greatly strengthens them with buff magic, Butler Kim prevents them from relying on outside help, Team Leader Choi and Song Song are lifted into the air, and Im Kkeokjeong leads the tank formation. After a five-hour raid, the new Hunters defeat the Stone Golem.

More than ten Iron Golems then approach the exhausted group. When the new Guild members beg for help, Team Leader Choi refuses, and Jin Taekyung appears in a red flash to split one Iron Golem cleanly in half. He grins and remarks that mob farming is extremely profitable.

active_continuity: Mae Jonghak is publicly recognized as the Sword Saint despite his Returned to Youth appearance.
Cheongpung can move again and wanted to see Taekyung as soon as he woke; dumplings quieted him.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious; the Luoyang Strange Physician examined him but said there was no treatment available for now.
Taekyung considers Jeok both his Master and the equivalent of a close grandfather.
Mae suspects Dark Heaven may seek direct confrontation or may be a smokescreen or subordinate organization of the Demonic Cult.
The Blood Lord, Temporary Strength Pill, and Exploding Blood Demonic Art carry the Demonic Cult's scent, but the Blood Lord's sorcery is darker and unfamiliar.
Hong Dao's letter calls Taekyung the Morning Star who will drive away darkness.
